description: A head-to-head, team, or lobby PvP match receipt stored in a participant's repository.

main.description: Published in one or more participants' PDSs after a competitive or asynchronous PvP match (fighting games, chess/board games, TCGs, arena/BR lobbies, racing). Supports publisher/host signing AND serverless peer-to-peer multi-participant DID co-signing (`signatures` signed by every DID in `participants`), Elo/Glicko-2 rating deltas, `matchId` deduplication across opponents' repos, and deterministic `replay` blobs.

game.description: AT-URI of the game definition record (`games.atmosphere.define`).

matchId.description: Optional shared deterministic match identifier so AppViews deduplicate copies published across multiple participants' PDSs into one canonical match log.

leaderboard.description: Optional AT-URI of the ranked ladder (`games.opengaming.leaderboard.definition`, typically `rankingMode: "latest"`) affected by this match.

challenge.description: Optional AT-URI of the tournament bracket or event (`games.opengaming.challenge.definition`) this match belonged to.

bestOf.description: Optional set length (e.g. `3` for Best-of-3, `5` for First-to-3 / Best-of-5).

participants.description: All competing players/teams in this match (ordered by placement or seat).

dimensions.description: Optional match ruleset, stage, time-control, or format variables (e.g. `{ "timeControl": "3+2", "stage": "final-destination" }`).

details.description: Optional open-union set/round breakdown (e.g. `#setBreakdown` or a genre-specific PGN, decklist, or combat log object).

version.description: Optional game balance patch or ruleset version identifier.

replay.description: Optional deterministic match replay, rollback input stream, or PGN/turn log blob.

signatures.description: Optional inline CID-first cryptographic attestations (`games.opengaming.defs#inlineSignature`). May be signed by the game publisher / tournament host OR peer-to-peer co-signed by every DID in `participants`.

matchParticipant.description: Outcome, placement, character/deck, and optional rating delta for one participant in a `match.result`.

did.description: AT Protocol DID of the participant (optional for local guests or AI bots).

name.description: Optional display name or guest tag.

character.description: Optional fighter, archetype, deck, or faction played.

placement.description: Optional `1..N` finish order for free-for-all, racing, or battle-royale lobbies.

score.description: Optional games, rounds, stocks, or points won in this match (e.g. `2` in a `2-1` set).

scoreText.description: Optional formatted score or tiebreak text.

ratingBefore.description: Optional pre-match skill rating (e.g. Elo `1650` or scaled Glicko-2).

roundResult.description: Result of an individual game/round inside a multi-game set.

setBreakdown.description: Standardized round-by-round breakdown for fighting, card, board, or esports sets, attachable via `match.result#details`.

notation.description: Optional algebraic notation (e.g. Chess PGN) or compact turn summary.
